newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Chicago NBD view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Chicago NBD view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it raised its earnings per share estimates on First Chicago NBD Corp to $4.90 from $4.85 for 1997 and to $5.50 from $5.45 for 1998. It said it acted principally on improved trading results.
-- First Chicago NBD reported a 13.6 percent increase in Q1 earnings to $1.17 per share, which exceeded EVEREN's estimate of $1.16 and the consensus estimate of $1.15.
-- First Chicago NBD was off 7/8 at 52-3/8.
